method: No compile. headline: ALL 13 REFUSE LOUDLY AT -O0 AND SILENTLY AT -O3, AND THE PARTITION IS TWO WALLS, NO REMAINDER: 5 bodies (28 rows) refused by the generic-ABI wall in rederive_abi_sig, 8 bodies (8 rows) refused by the local-type fragment wall in gate_derived_body. Every cause is fail-closed-and-CORRECT; zero stale guards, zero defects, zero producer changes made by this lane.
silence_mechanism: At -O3 the marker gate refuses these rows first and logs nothing — none of the 13 appears in O3.flip.txt. At -O0 the marker verdict is not consulted, the bodies reach the flip gate, and the NEXT wall refuses each one with a WARN FALLBACK line carrying stage and reason. The loud channel existed in the recorded dumps all along; it had not been joined to the never-flip set.
